translations.text: Will you hear of David the good, and of his secret mind?
He greeted his Lord: "Truly you have tested me, Lord, and you know who I am, from the beginning to the end.
I cannot waver in my thoughts before you: you know all the paths, wherever I turn.
Wherever I turned my bridle, you quickly took note of it: you blocked the way before me, so that I turned back to follow you.
You have bound my tongue so firmly that I speak no word without your command.
How great is your knowledge, Christ, that is turned from me toward you! How could I escape you!
If I go up to heaven, you are there with a host; if my journey is to hell, you are present there: I cannot go into any land unless your hand holds me.
Now I will put away from me all murderers, all who urged me toward unjust wealth.
All who urged me toward unjust wealth are your enemies; I will be at feud with them.
Those who want to act against you, I will hate fiercely; for your glory I will make them all my enemies.
You, God, with your power, protect me on every side; with your strength take his arrows from him, do not give him the chance to shoot at me.
You made the soul for me, you placed it in me. You were aware of me at once, as soon as my mother bore me.
Nor can I deny what you did in secret, nor that from my birth I would become earth again.
If I go into the darkness, you have me there at once: I know that your night can be as bright as day.
Then I will set my wings very early; then I will begin to fly as no one has ever done before.
When I begin to fly as no one has ever done before, I will fly to the end of the far sea: I know that you will reach me there; I cannot go into any land unless your hand holds me.
Now choose me firmly for yourself, if I turn to follow you: you gracious God, turn me onward, and with your grace keep me for yourself forever."
